who-you-runtime.description: Bounded Who You validation: static, unit and Workerd integration; production provider calls and deployment excluded. Repository Contract CI retains scripts/check.sh.

checks.command: set -e; NODE_BIN="$(find /opt/hostedtoolcache/node -path '*/24.*/x64/bin/node' -print | sort -V | tail -n 1)"; test -n "$NODE_BIN"; export PATH="$(dirname "$NODE_BIN"):$PATH"; npm ci
set -e; NODE_BIN="$(find /opt/hostedtoolcache/node -path '*/24.*/x64/bin/node' -print | sort -V | tail -n 1)"; test -n "$NODE_BIN"; export PATH="$(dirname "$NODE_BIN"):$PATH"; npm run typecheck
set -e; NODE_BIN="$(find /opt/hostedtoolcache/node -path '*/24.*/x64/bin/node' -print | sort -V | tail -n 1)"; test -n "$NODE_BIN"; export PATH="$(dirname "$NODE_BIN"):$PATH"; npm run lint
set -e; NODE_BIN="$(find /opt/hostedtoolcache/node -path '*/24.*/x64/bin/node' -print | sort -V | tail -n 1)"; test -n "$NODE_BIN"; export PATH="$(dirname "$NODE_BIN"):$PATH"; npm run test:unit

set -e; NODE_BIN="$(find /opt/hostedtoolcache/node -path '*/24.*/x64/bin/node' -print | sort -V | tail -n 1)"; test -n "$NODE_BIN"; export PATH="$(dirname "$NODE_BIN"):$PATH"; npm run test:integration
